name: 甘奈
text: よーっし、これで洗い物、おしまい！
trans: Alright, and that's all we have to wash!

name: 甜花
text: 今日……いつもより……お皿、多かったね……
trans: We had... a lot more plates... than usual today......

name: 甘奈
text:
ママ、甘奈たちの好きなメニュー、いっぱい
作ってくれたもんね～
trans: Mama made a lot of our favorite foods today～

name: 甜花
text: うん……！　甜花、エネルギー……満タン
trans: Yeah......! Tenka's... full of energy......

name: 甘奈
text:
甘奈も満タン！　
これで明日の旅企画もバッチリだよー！
trans:
Me too! And with that we're all set for tomorrow's
trip!

name: 甘奈
text:
サイコロ使うって言ってたよね☆
当たりの目……とかもあるのかな！？
trans:
They said we'd be using dice☆
I wonder if there'll be winning numbers or something!

name: 甜花
text: 当たり……！　甜花……絶対、出す……！
trans: Winning......! Tenka... will definitelly... roll it......!

name: 甘奈
text: えへへ、甜花ちゃんなら本当に出しちゃうかもね☆
trans: Ehehe, it might actually show up for you☆

name: 甜花
text: にへへ……そうかな……？
trans: Nihehe...... you think so......?

name: 甘奈
text:
うん！　だって甜花ちゃん、
サイコロ使ったボードゲームとか強いもん！
trans:
Yeah! I mean you're so good at all those board games
that use dice!

name: 甘奈
text:
ここぞ！　って時は、
いつも当たりを出してた気がするなあ
trans:
I feel like you always get the right rolls when you
need them.

name: 甜花
text:
そ、そうだった……かも……！？
……でも……最近、全然やってない……
trans:
H-Has that happened... maybe you're right......!?
......But...... Tenka hasn't played those recently......

name: 甘奈
text:
じゃあ、久しぶりにやってみよっか
明日からの仕事が成功しますように……って！
trans:
Okay then, let's play one now, so that our work goes
well tomorrow...!

name: 甘奈
text: 甘奈、取ってくるね☆
trans: I'm gonna go grab it☆

name: 甘奈
text:
甜花ちゃん、あったよ！
ほら！　魔王を倒す冒険の！
trans:
I found it, Tenka-chan! Look! An adventure to take
down the evil king!

name: 甘奈
text: 甜花ちゃん、これ大好きだったよね！
trans: You loved this one, right!?

name: 甜花
text:
うん……！
にへへ……なーちゃん、覚えててくれたんだ……
trans:
Yeah......! Nihehe...... thanks for remembering...
Naa-chan......

name: 甘奈
text: えへへ、当然だよっ！　じゃ、早速準備しよっ！
trans:
Ehehe, of course I remember! Now then, let's get it
going!

name: 甘奈＆甜花
text: せーの！　じゃんけんポン！
trans: Ready and! Rock, paper, scissors!

name: 甜花
text: 勝ち……！　じゃあ、甜花……先攻……！
trans: Tenka won......! So then... Tenka will... go first......!

name: 甘奈
text: 最初のエリアで職業が決まるんだよね～
trans: You decide your class at the beginning, right～?

name: 甜花
text: うん……甜花……強いの、狙う……
trans: Yeah...... Tenka... wants the strong one......

name: 甘奈
text:
ほらほら甜花ちゃん！
やっぱりでしょ！
trans: Oh look Tenka-chan! I was right, wasn't I!?

name: 甜花
text:
うん……！
甜花も……まだまだ、やれる……！
trans: Yeah......! Tenka's... still got it......!

name: 甘奈
text: じゃあ、次は甘奈だね──
trans: Okay, now it's my turn──

name: 甜花
text:
──あ……！　甜花、前衛だから……
なーちゃん、後衛のジョブ……狙って……！
trans:
──Oh......! Tenka's... a frontliner... so...... you should
play... someone in the back......!

name: 甘奈
text:
えへへ！　勇者甜花様の命令、承りました！
甘奈、後衛を狙いますっ！
trans:
Ehehe! By your orders, Miss Hero Tenka-sama! I'll try
to get one of those!

name: 甘奈
text: それっ！
trans: That one!

name: 甘奈
text: ３の職業は……えっと……
trans: Three of them are... hmmm......

name: 甘奈
text: あ、僧侶だっ！
trans: Oh, the priest!

name: 甜花
text:
なーちゃん、ナイス……！
これで、甜花……安心して……斬りこめる……！
trans:
Nice one... Naa-chan......! This way... Tenka can kill
opponents... without any worries......!

name: 甘奈
text: うんっ☆　甘奈に回復はお任せあれっ、勇者様！
trans:
Yeah☆ Please allow me to heal your wounds, oh
Hero-sama!

name: 甜花
text: にへへ……うむ……！
trans: Nihehe...... Indeed......!

name: 甜花
text: いざ……突撃……！
trans: Come now...... we ride......!

name: 甜花
text: バトルマスだ……！　来い……！
trans: A battle master......! Let us fight......!

name: 甘奈
text: 甜花ちゃん、頑張れ～！
trans: You got this, Tenka-chan～!

name: 甜花
text: ４以上なら攻撃……３以下だと、ダメージ……
trans:
Rolling a 4 or higher is an attack...... 3 or less is taking
damage......

name: 甜花
text: ……あうぅ……ダメージ……
trans: ......Auu...... Tenka took damage......

name: 甘奈
text:
大丈夫！？　甜花ちゃん！
えっと、回復魔法の使い方は……えっと……
trans:
Are you okay, Tenka-chan!? Um... How do I use healing
magic again...? Umm...

name: 甜花
text: まだまだ、平気……今度こそは……えいっ……！
trans: Tenka's... still okay...... Tenka will... hit this time......!

name: 甘奈
text: やった！　攻撃！
trans: Yay! You got an attack!

name: 甜花
trans: ......Steel yourself......!

name: 甜花
text: 甜花……スラッシュ……！
trans: Tenka... slash......!

name: 甘奈
text: 一撃だ～！
trans: You one shot him～!

name: 甜花
text: 甜花の……敵じゃない……
trans: You're... not even a threat......

name: 甘奈
text:
えへへ！　やったねっ！
じゃあ、早速回復を──
trans: Ehehe! Great job! Now then, to heal you──

name: 甘奈
text: ──甘奈ヒール！
trans: ──Amana heal!

name: 甜花
text:
ありがと、なーちゃん……！
この調子で……ボス……倒そう……！
trans:
Thanks... Naa-chan......! At this rate... we should be
able... to beat the boss......!

name: 甘奈
text: おーっ！
trans: Wooo!

name: 甘奈
text: ……甜花ちゃん、次の一撃で決められそう？
trans:
...Do you think you can get this guy in one hit too,
Tenka-chan?

name: 甜花
text:
……甜花のスキル……
『ラストスラッシャー』を使えば……いける、かも……
trans:
...Tenka thinks that... she might be able to... if she
uses her skill... "Last Slasher"......

name: 甜花
text: でも……これ……１じゃないと、ミス……
trans: But...... if Tenka... doesn't land a 1... then it'll miss......

name: 甜花
text:
１だとしても……HPを犠牲にして発動する技だから……
今の甜花の体力じゃ無理……
trans:
And even if... she lands it...... the skill... uses Tenka's
HP to activate... and her health is too low......

name: 甜花
text: ここでゲームオーバー……
trans: Looks like this is game over......

name: 甘奈
text: 甜花ちゃん……
trans: Tenka-chan......

name: 甘奈
text:
────まだ！
まだ終わりじゃないよ！
trans: ────Not yet! The game isn't over yet!

name: 甘奈
text:
甘奈のスキルにね、
味方を全回復する魔法があるんだ……！
trans: I have can still heal my allies with an ability...!

name: 甜花
text:
で、でも……その魔法は命と引き換え……
なーちゃんが倒れちゃ──
trans:
B-But...... if you use that magic... then you'll have to
sacrifice yourself──

name: 甘奈
text: ──えいっ！
trans: ──There you go!

name: 甜花
text: なーちゃん……！
trans: Naa-chan......!

name: 甘奈
text: えへへ、後は任せたよ……！　甜花ちゃん！
trans: Ehehe, I leave the rest to you, Tenka-chan!

name: 甜花
text:
……うん……！
甜花、頑張る……！　それっ……！！
trans:
......Okay......!
Tenka will... do her best......! Go......!!

name: 甜花
text: ……倒せた──
trans: ......We beat him──

name: 甘奈
text: ──やったね～！　甜花ちゃん！　大勝利だよ～っ！
trans:
──We did it～! You did it Tenka-chan! That was
insane～!

name: 甜花
text:
うん……！
にへへ……なーちゃんの、おかげ……
trans: Yeah......! Nihehe... it's all thanks... to you......

name: 甘奈
text: ううん！　甜花ちゃんが決めたおかげだよ～！
trans: No! It's only because you locked in～!

name: 甘奈
text:
あ、あれ……！　もうこんな時間！？
早く寝ないと……！
trans: H-Huh...? It's already this late!? We gotta sleep...!

name: 甜花
text:
あうぅ……甜花、明日の準備……
まだ、終わってない……
trans: Auu... Tenka... still isn't ready for tomorrow......

name: 甘奈
text:
甘奈も忘れ物のチェックしなくちゃ！
急いでやっちゃお……！
trans:
I gotta make sure I have everything too! Let's get a
move on...!
